notes:
Status: Closed-lost (selected Together)

Summary: mid-market logistics SaaS using LLMs for reranking + semantic search in their shipment optimization product. Strong interest in predictable latency and tenant isolation. Ultimately chose Together citing faster private deployment path and lower committed pricing. No technical red flags from POC, but commercial + org changes killed momentum.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2025-11-15: Intro call (Maya + Ravi) — discovery: need per-tenant data residency (EU), strict audit logging, SSO. Customer: 'must support HSM/KMS and EU-only hosts'.
- 2025-12-02: Security questionnaire submitted; security team asked for KMS flow and audit retention details. Shared security FAQ (drive link).
- 2026-01-10: POC kickoff — small reranking workload (1k qps simulated), model: open-llama variant, latency SLO 70ms p95 for short queries.
- 2026-01-25: POC results: throughput OK under dedicated pool but p95s spiked on warmup; SE notes kernel tuning path and batching recommendations. Shared Optimize runbook.
- 2026-01-30: Internal turnover — Jordan (lead ML infra) left role. Loss of champion caused delay in procurement follow-ups.
- 2026-02-12: Procurement + security review meeting. Procurement preferred single-vendor stack and a firm committed capacity discount.
- 2026-02-18: Exec decision communicated: choose Together. Reasoning: faster timeline for private VPC/on-prem, better short-term pricing on committed capacity, and out-of-the-box HSM integration in EU region.

Key takeaways / why we lost:
- Commercial: Together offered a cleaner committed capacity discount that fit their FY26 budget profile.
- Security/org: preference for fewer vendors + immediate HSM/KMS availability in EU. Redwood had roadmap for KMS/HSM but no immediate GA for their exact flow.
- Champion loss: departure of Jordan halted internal momentum; no replacement willing to drive second evaluation.

Open items / follow-up plan:
- Mark as closed-lost, reason: lost_to_competitor.
- Action: send a short ROI one-pager and updated quantization/latency improvements (Ravi) — target send by 2026-03-05.
- Re-engage window: 6 months (late Aug 2026) — monitor together contract and available capacity notes.

Quotes / capture: "We can't introduce two model vendors into core infra right now — procurement wants a single vendor play and an immediate EU HSM story."
